integrity: The exact map normalization was cross-checked in same-object published literature. The proof solves the conditional moment equations induced by the doubling Perron operator, and the bundled checker verifies the Fourier coefficient algebra. Originality searches covered conditional mean, conditional variance, invariant measure, stationary moments, Perron–Frobenius formulations, and the exact trigonometric profile.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes the invariant measure has Lebesgue first-coordinate marginal; other doubling-map marginals are outside its scope.
Only the first two conditional moments are determined; no closed full conditional law or dimension formula is claimed.

title: Exact conditional variance profile of the Kaplan–Yorke stationary measure
